quote: The driver of a vehicle approaching an intersection shall yield the right-of-way to a vehicle which has entered the intersection from a different highway. Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.

activation.condition: An ego driver approaches an intersection after another vehicle entered it from a different highway.

obligation.description: Yield right-of-way to the already-entered vehicle if subsection 1 applies.

exceptions.source_clause: Except as otherwise provided in subsection 4 [NRS-484B-250-4], this section does not apply at intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices or to vehicles approaching each other from opposite directions, when the driver of one of the vehicles is intending to or is making a left turn.
exceptions.description: Official control, opposing left-turn context and subsection 4 qualification require independent review.

timing.description: Measure original body entry and exit transitions and preserve their 20 Hz sample brackets.

judgment_calls_needed.note: Identify the same physical roadway crossing for both vehicles; a median opening label alone is insufficient.
Review original road and public-highway identity sources for both approaches.
Use original footprint transitions with an uninterrupted Native frame clock.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: intersections controlled by official traffic-control devices
judgment_calls_needed.note: Review the governing device and subsection 4 separately; inoperative readback is not an applicability ruling.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: approaching each other from opposite directions
judgment_calls_needed.note: Review original approach trajectories and left-turn intent for the statutory exclusion.

parameter_refs.name: ego_response_request
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: yield_before_entry or advance_before_other_exit; requested behavior is not measured behavior
